subject.title: Preserve aborted sessions across restart opt-in

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor `session.restartContinuation` as a core session config contract for preserving aborted main-session ids across controlled Gateway restarts?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, but it adds a new compatibility-sensitive session config surface and changes restart-time session reuse semantics, which repo policy treats as maintainer-level product direction.

options.title: Close Until Sponsored
options.body: Close this contributor PR now and invite a maintainer to reopen or sponsor the direction if this explicit opt-in should become core product surface.

options.title: Sponsor The Opt-In
options.body: Accept the new config contract and continue review toward landing with any owner-requested docs or upgrade proof.

options.title: Choose Config-Free Recovery
options.body: Reject this knob shape and redirect the canonical issue toward a broader restart-recovery design that does not add another session config option.

recommendation.title: Close Until Sponsored
recommendation.body: Close this contributor PR now and invite a maintainer to reopen or sponsor the direction if this explicit opt-in should become core product surface.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current history match for the terminal transcript/session registry behavior that this config would modify.
